notes.title: Sorcerer's Choice: Angel or Demon and other JAST visual novels on sale!
notes.content:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43864321/55ee0f30a6d5c40d867f0c2c9406c453d2c4ceef.png[/img]

[h2]Get [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2325470/Sorcerers_Choice_Angel_or_Demon/]Sorcerer's Choice: Angel or Demon[/url] at a discount of 30% off![/h2]
